purpose: Teach: 丸太/水色/土手/浜辺/ウロコ/ニオイ/吊り/ハズレ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、丸太テーブルがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really loved the live-edge table.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Noticing something small that mattered to someone. Gentle pace, warm undercurrent. A quiet moment of connection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、水色のカップを選ばれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they chose the light blue cup, remember?
lines.style: Easy, conversational recall. Not announcing—just sharing a small detail with someone close. Warm, familiar rhythm. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、川の土手をお散歩されてからご来店だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they came straight from walking along the riverbank before stopping by.
lines.style: Thoughtful, piecing together a picture. Slow, connecting each detail. Slightly wondering—admiring that someone took the time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、浜辺カフェに憧れてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they mentioned wanting to visit a beach café someday.
lines.style: Wistful, understanding longing. Quiet voice, like she's holding that wish with them. Gentle trailing-off, respecting their dream.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーの抽出で「目からウロコ」って驚いてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they were genuinely amazed when they watched the coffee extraction—had that moment of real surprise.
lines.style: Pleased, small laugh underneath. Noticing the genuine delight in a customer. Warmer than before—this one landed. Light and knowing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、当店のコーヒー豆のニオイをお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they actually complimented the smell of our coffee beans.
lines.style: Modest but genuine. Not brushing off praise, just stating it simply. Warm tone, grounded. A small pride in something they care about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、吊りカゴの観葉植物をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they said such nice things about the hanging plants.
lines.style: Gentle approval. Noticing that beauty matters to people, that noticing matters. Soft voice, contented. A small happiness in being seen.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ガチャでハズレばかりだって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they were laughing about how they never win at those gacha games.
lines.style: Amused, knowing. Understanding the humor in small defeats. Light warmth, sympathetic laughter. A moment of shared lightness between them.
